scope: Read-only static inspection of supplied workflow exports and offline execution of scoring code; no webhook requests, email sends, imports, or activation performed.

webhook.authentication: No authentication parameter or credential configured on webhook node
webhook.productionHost: Not specified in export; active flag does not verify live deployment

precedence: flat score or S packed number
acceptedInput.nativeContact: Exact configured Typeform field ids, with email-type fallback, first text answer name fallback and first choice opt-in fallback. Both exports use identical field ids; current live Typeform ids unverified.
acceptedInput.flatScores: Number coercion; missing categories default zero. No finite-number, integer, nonnegative, or maximum bounds validation.
acceptedInput.packedScore: cat4*1000000 + cat3*10000 + cat2*100 + cat1; decode last eight left-padded digits in 2-digit groups. Any flat score or S takes priority over category fields.
acceptedInput.rawSymptomMapping: All defined psychological labels map to zero; physical labels absent. Raw selections do not yield usable scores and populate debug warnings.

workflows.resultRule: All four counts > 0 => 5; otherwise if cat1+cat2 > cat3+cat4 choose cat1>cat2 ? 1 : 2; otherwise choose cat3>cat4 ? 3 : 4. Zero therefore produces result 4.

categoryLabels: Category 4 — Cardiovascular & Chronic Disease Risk Dominant

payload.mailing_list: No, just send me the results

frontend.compatibility: Local counts payload selects supported flat category branch and avoids unfinished raw-symptom map. Category count math matches for all valid nonzero combinations; zeros differ.

responses.emailValidation: Only checks that trimmed patientEmail contains @
responses.preflight: No explicit OPTIONS webhook/node configuration in export. Response CORS headers alone do not prove browser preflight works for deployed host.

email.branches: Every input containing @ proceeds to one Gmail send regardless of mailingList value.

contentMeaning.5: Hormone imbalance affecting one or more major health areas

email.zero: Result 4 selects cardiometabolic-risk wording even with no symptoms.
email.mailingConsent: Captured and preserved but never evaluated or used to subscribe. Result email includes related products/tests without opt-in-specific suppression.
email.nameEscaping: Patient name is title-cased but interpolated into HTML without HTML escaping.

workflows.crm: No CRM, mailing-list provider, database, Set, or consent routing node in either export.

failureAndDuplicates.successTiming: Respond - Success runs only after Gmail node completes.
failureAndDuplicates.customErrorHandling: No error workflow setting, retryOnFail, continueOnFail, onError, deduplication, or persistence configured in exported nodes/settings.
failureAndDuplicates.failureResponse: Send/build failure has no explicit controlled JSON response branch. Actual HTTP failure/default depends on n8n runtime.
failureAndDuplicates.duplicateBehavior: Each valid request can send another result email. No idempotency key, token dedupe, or email/date dedupe exists; client retry after uncertain delivery can duplicate email.

integrationImplications: Keep sending cat1..cat4 counts. Do not send the frontend total score as flat score: workflow interprets score as packed digits.
Reconcile all-zero handling before sending patient emails.
Confirm category clinical meanings and score mapping with source owner: local display names and workflow email interpretation differ for categories 1 through 3.
Do not claim CRM registration or mailing-list enrollment from these exports; neither is implemented.
Treat consent for newsletter separately from the requested assessment email.
Require meaningful delivery-failure response, deployed CORS verification, and duplicate-send protection before browser integration.
